source: PHC Core Rules v1.0, rules 1.6 (Blessing 2.0, docs/design/blessing-2.0-spec.md) and 1.6.1 (Faith 2.1, docs/design/faith-2.1-spec.md; section 14 items 701-723) + Narrator's World Bible

tags.name: Protect
tags.text: Shield an ally, Interpose, Brace, or take a hit for someone.

tags.name: Mercy
tags.text: Accept a surrender, or end a fight without killing a surrendered enemy.

tags.name: Judge
tags.text: Kill or Down an enemy that harmed a surrendered or Downed creature this fight.

tags.name: Burn
tags.text: Deal Fire damage or set Burning.

tags.name: Storm
tags.text: Deal Storm damage (SHOCK, the Storm tone, lightning).

tags.name: Trick
tags.text: A Trickster move, hiding, a False Image, a feint or a swap.

tags.name: Supply
tags.text: Reload an ally, throw a stim, hand over items, place cover.

tags.name: Hold
tags.text: End a turn Braced, Anchored or in Overwatch.

tags.name: Flee
tags.text: Retreat out of a fight, or Disengage away from enemies.

tags.name: Desecrate
tags.text: Damage a shrine, a corpse or holy ground (map objects tagged holy).

tags.name: Betray
tags.text: Attack a creature on your own side.

tags.name: Cower
tags.text: End a turn Hidden while an ally is Downed.

whispers.name: Luck
whispers.text: You or an ally in sight: +2 on the next roll.

whispers.name: Health
whispers.text: You or an ally in sight heals 15 × Blessing power.

whispers.name: Protection
whispers.text: You or an ally in sight gains a 15 × Blessing power shield.

whispers.name: Courage
whispers.text: End Fear or Shaken on you or an ally in sight.

whispers.name: Guidance
whispers.text: Reveal Hidden enemies and traps within 6, and +2 on your next notice roll.

whispers.name: Safe Passage
whispers.text: Your next move this turn provokes no opportunity attacks.

vows.name: Mercy
vows.broken_when: you damage a surrendered or Downed enemy

vows.name: Stand
vows.broken_when: you end a turn farther from the nearest enemy than you started it

vows.name: Bare Hands
vows.broken_when: you attack with a gun or a spell

vows.name: No Magic but Theirs
vows.broken_when: you draw, Evoke or Begin (Sigil or Outburst)

vows.name: Nobody Left Behind
vows.broken_when: an ally is still Downed when the fight ends

notes: Rules 1.6 (8 Nov 2026). Every number is provisional (spec section 14). Lines are picked by the engine (seeded), never written by the Narrator.

items.name: Holy Father Nerukhan
items.costume: A stern holy father of the Lumeri saint-church who speaks for the saints; never breaks costume. 'Only the saints may judge.'

grudge.text: Nerukhan names you before the saints: you start every fight Marked, and every other patron hears of it.

accord_terms: Pacts first: answers only those sworn to the Lumeri faith
Keep the costume: never speaks as anything but the Holy Father
The Veil: miracles are always framed as the saints' judgement

rites.name: Confession
rites.text: Confess before the saints, out of a fight (a story button). Once a session: +4 Devotion XP.

rites.name: Tithe at a Shrine
rites.text: Leave a share of your loot at a Lumeri shrine (the Narrator marks it kept).

intervention.text: An enemy damages a surrendered or Downed creature: that enemy takes 20 Soul.

hymns.name: Saint's Shield
hymns.text: An ally in sight gains a 40 shield.

hymns.name: Judgement
hymns.text: An enemy in sight takes 40 Soul; ×2 if it harmed the helpless this fight.

hymns.name: Absolution
hymns.text: An ally is cleansed of every condition and heals 30.

miracle.name: The Saints' Verdict
miracle.text: Every enemy that harmed the helpless this fight takes 60 Soul and is Stunned 1 round.

answered: The saints have heard you, child.
Kneel, then stand. You are answered.
Judgement is theirs. This much is yours.
refused: You reach above your station, child.
The saints do not answer the presumptuous. Ask again, humbler.
taboo: Who made you judge? Not I.
The saints saw that. So did I.
Desecration. I am writing this down.
vow_kept: Your word held. The saints take note.
A vow honoured. Rare, these days.
vow_broken: A broken vow is a broken pot, child.
I heard the oath. I heard it break.
witnessed: The saints are watching. Behave accordingly.
Every eye in the chapel is on you now.
intervention: Only the saints may judge. They have.
Strike the fallen? Not in my sight.
miracle: THE SAINTS HAVE RENDERED THEIR VERDICT.
Let every cruel hand be counted.
conversion: Welcome to the Lumeri faith. Confession is before every battle.
Another soul for the saints. Mind the candles.
farewell: Go, then. The saints keep a list.
You knelt here once, child. Remember it.
I release no one. I only let them walk.

items.source_note: Named in the 2020 material; reading as a Celestial in a pact is from the World Bible. Tenets, rites and blessings are new.

items.name: The Quartermaster
items.costume: The logistics god of a war that never ended: a clerk's visor, a requisition stamp worn on a chain, and a deep love of forms filed in triplicate.
items.archetype: the quartermaster of a war god

grudge.text: Your rations were docked on the way out: you start every fight with Nausea (−1 AP).

accord_terms: Pacts first
Keep the costume
Quotas: asks for bots in kind, so prefers prayers made after a hard fight
tenets: Leave no one on the field

rites.name: Inventory
rites.text: Count and log every round you carry after a rest (a story button, once a rest has been taken this session). Once a session: +4 Devotion XP.

rites.name: Requisition Form
rites.text: File a proper request before taking anything from a depot or a fallen soldier (the Narrator marks it kept).

intervention.text: Your gun runs dry: it reloads, free.

hymns.name: Resupply
hymns.text: An ally in sight reloads every weapon for free and regains 1 Supply.

hymns.name: Dig In
hymns.text: An ally gains half cover where they stand until they move, and is Braced.

hymns.name: Covering Fire
hymns.text: A 3×3 area in sight: every enemy in it makes a Body save or is Pinned 1 round.

miracle.name: Requisition Approved
miracle.text: The whole squad is restocked (ammo, Supplies, one standard core each) and gets +2 AP next turn.

refused: That form is above your clearance.
Come back with a supervisor's signature.
taboo: Retreat was not on the requisition.
You broke a crate of perfectly good salvage.
That will be deducted from your pay.
vow_kept: Good. That goes on your record.
Exemplary. I may frame this one.
vow_broken: Your vow has been marked VOID.
I had such high hopes for that form.
witnessed: I'm watching the inventory, and you.
intervention: Out of rounds? Not on my watch.
miracle: I have waited a thousand years to stamp this.
conversion: Welcome to the supply corps. Here is your locker key.
farewell: Return your locker key on the way out.
Discharge papers, stamped. Don't lose them.
Transfer approved. Reluctantly.

items.name: The Laughing Mask
items.costume: The trickster: a grinning mask that never comes off. Joined the Accords to troll them and demands a show.

grudge.text: The Mask leaves something slippery at every curtain-up: you start every fight Prone.

accord_terms: Pacts first
Keep the costume: never removes the mask
The Veil: every miracle must look like luck
tenets: A lie told well is a gift

rites.name: The Opening Act
rites.text: Tell a joke to the room, out of a fight (a story button). Once a session: +4 Devotion XP.

rites.name: A Good Prank
rites.text: Pull a prank someone important will remember (the Narrator marks it kept).

intervention.text: An enemy rolls a natural 1 against you: it falls Prone.

hymns.name: Lucky Break
hymns.text: An ally's next failed roll is rerolled at +5.

hymns.name: Switcheroo
hymns.text: Swap two units in sight within 6 (an enemy gets a Brain save).

hymns.name: Pratfall
hymns.text: An enemy in sight makes a Body save or falls Prone and drops its held weapon.

miracle.name: Encore
miracle.text: Every ally may repeat the last action they took this round, for free, now.

taboo: Boring!
Hiding? While your friend bleeds? Boo.
Mercy? In MY show?
vow_kept: You kept it! I'm almost proud.
vow_broken: I knew you would. Everyone knew.
The crowd loved that, mind you.
intervention: Slippery floor. Who put that there?
farewell: Leaving mid-show? Bold.
Exit, stage left! Mind the trapdoor.
Fine. Everyone gets one walk-off.

items.name: The Toll-Keeper
items.domain: The dead, the last crossing, passage paid
items.costume: A quiet Celestial in a boatman's oilskin with a coin box at the hip, who answers at dusk; the guide of the dead at the last crossing.

taboo_notes.kill: only the kill of a surrendered or Downed creature

grudge.text: The river drags at your legs: you start every fight Slowed.

accord_terms: Answers at dusk, or when someone is dying
Never ferries the living
Keeps the coin box closed
tenets: The dying are not to be hurried

rites.name: Vigil
rites.text: Keep a vigil for the dead at a rest (a story button, once a rest has been taken this session). Once a session: +4 Devotion XP.

rites.name: Pay the Toll
rites.text: Put a coin on the eyes of someone who died near you (the Narrator marks it kept).

intervention.text: An ally would drop to 0 HP: they stay at 1 HP instead.

hymns.name: Coin for the Ferry
hymns.text: A Downed ally in sight is stabilised and stands at 10 HP.

hymns.name: Hold the Gate
hymns.text: Until your next turn, allies in sight can't drop below 1 HP.

hymns.name: Last Crossing
hymns.text: An enemy in sight at a quarter HP or less makes a Heart save or dies (bosses take 40 Soul instead).

miracle.name: Turned Back at the Shore
miracle.text: An ally who died this fight returns at 1 HP.

answered: The boat waits. Not for you. Not yet.
refused: The water is too high for that.
taboo: You sent one over who had already yielded.
That one was not yours to send.
Leave the dead their rest.
witnessed: I am at the shore. I see you.
miracle: THE SHORE GIVES BACK WHAT IT TOOK.
conversion: You have a seat on the boat now. Not today.
The river knows your name now.
farewell: The river remembers who crossed it.
Keep your coin. You will need it later.
Go. The water is patient.

items.name: Mother Ember
items.domain: The hearth, home, the ones who come back
items.costume: The hearth-mother: a kettle always on, an apron, flour on the sleeves; calls everyone 'love'.

grudge.text: Mother Ember isn't angry, only disappointed: you start every fight Shaken.

accord_terms: Answers anyone who is cold or hungry
Never refuses a guest
Keeps the fire lit

rites.name: Share a Meal
rites.text: Give a ration to the squad's table (a story button: one food item from your pack). Once a session: +4 Devotion XP.

rites.name: Keep the Fire
rites.text: Keep a fire lit through a cold night for others (the Narrator marks it kept).

intervention.text: An ally drops below a quarter HP: they heal 15.

hymns.name: Warm Hands
hymns.text: An ally in sight heals 40.

hymns.name: Hearthlight
hymns.text: A 3×3 area in sight: allies starting a turn in it heal 10, for 3 rounds.

hymns.name: Feed the Fire
hymns.text: An ally gets +1 AP now (the ceiling applies) and loses Weakened and Slowed.

miracle.name: Everyone Home
miracle.text: The whole squad heals to full, and Downed allies stand.

refused: Ask me again when you've rested.
taboo: We don't turn on our own in this house.
Hiding while they need you? Come out.
I'm not angry. I'm disappointed.
vow_kept: Kept your word. Have a biscuit.
vow_broken: We'll talk about this at home.
witnessed: I can see you from the kitchen.
miracle: Nobody's left out in the cold tonight.
conversion: There's always room at the table.
farewell: Wrap up warm, love. Wherever you're going.
There'll always be a plate for you. Always.
Go on, then. Write.

items.name: Old Overcast
items.domain: Thunder, the sky, a good loud entrance
items.costume: The thunder sky-father, played big and theatrical: a beard of cloud, a lightning rod carried like a sceptre. Has a rival Thunder-Father (a future patron).

grudge.text: Old Overcast thunders at your every entrance: you start every fight Dazed.

accord_terms: Answers loudly or not at all
Never shares a storm
Keeps the rival out of his sky

rites.name: Stand in the Storm
rites.text: Bellow a challenge at the sky, out of a fight (a story button). Once a session: +4 Devotion XP.

rites.name: Best the Rival
rites.text: Outdo a worshipper of the rival Thunder-Father (the Narrator marks it kept).

intervention.text: You kill an enemy: 20 Storm to the nearest other enemy.

hymns.name: Thunderclap
hymns.text: Every enemy within 2 of a tile in sight is pushed 1 and makes a Heart save or is Shaken.

hymns.name: Lightning Rod
hymns.text: 50 Elemental (Storm) to an enemy in sight, chaining to 1 more within 2 at half.

hymns.name: Gather the Clouds
hymns.text: Until your next turn, allies' Storm riders count one stage higher.

miracle.name: The Sky Answers
miracle.text: A 3×3 area in sight takes 80 Elemental (Storm), and everyone in it is Shaken.

refused: Too small a voice for so large a sky!
taboo: RUNNING? From a little weather?
Hiding is for drizzle.
I saw that. The whole sky saw that.
vow_broken: You broke it like cheap pottery!
Thunder never breaks its word. Only you.
Disgraceful. Even the rain is embarrassed.
witnessed: ALL EYES ON YOU, SMALL ONE!
conversion: You are under my sky now.
My rival will hate this. Excellent.
farewell: LEAVE, THEN! THE SKY HAS OTHER FAVOURITES!
You'll hear from me. Everyone hears from me.
Go to my rival, then. I DARE you.

items.name: The Matchmaker
items.domain: Love, bonds, the people you'd die for
items.costume: The love goddess, played as a wedding planner: a clipboard, a seating chart, and spools of red thread.

taboo_notes.kill: only the kill of a surrendered or Downed creature

grudge.text: The Matchmaker tells everyone about the break-up: you start every fight Weakened, with no heart for it.

accord_terms: Answers anyone in love, or anyone who should be
Never breaks a bond she tied
Plans everything

rites.name: Tie a Thread
rites.text: Tie a red thread on a friend's wrist, out of a fight (a story button). Once a session: +4 Devotion XP.

rites.name: Bring Two Together
rites.text: Reconcile two people at odds (the Narrator marks it kept).

intervention.text: An ally is hit while next to you: half the damage moves to you.

hymns.name: Red Thread
hymns.text: Link two allies in sight for 2 rounds; damage to either is split between them.

hymns.name: Sweet Nothings
hymns.text: An enemy in sight makes a Heart save or can't attack you or your linked allies next turn.

hymns.name: Together
hymns.text: Two adjacent allies each get +2 to hit and +2 Defense until your next turn.

miracle.name: Love Conquers
miracle.text: Every non-boss enemy in sight makes a Heart save or surrenders.

refused: Not on the seating chart, sorry.
That is NOT in the plan.
taboo: You did NOT just hit your own date.
They had already said yes. To surrender.
I am crossing you off the guest list.
vow_kept: Promises kept are my favourite kind.
You kept it. I'm going to cry.
vow_broken: You broke a promise. In front of the guests?
witnessed: All eyes on the happy couple!
miracle: Everyone, put down your weapons and hug.
conversion: A new name on my guest list.
farewell: It's not you, darling. It's definitely you.
I'll keep your seat warm. For a while.
Fine. But I'm keeping the gifts.

items.name: The Counting Weaver
items.domain: Fate, the count, what is owed
items.costume: The fate-spinner, played as an auditor: a loom of ledger tape and an abacus of beads that clicks while she listens.

grudge.text: The Weaver keeps a knot of your thread: you start every fight Pinned.

accord_terms: Answers anyone who keeps an honest count
Never alters a thread already woven
Bills in arrears
tenets: Keep your place in the pattern

rites.name: Settle Accounts
rites.text: Read out every debt you owe after a rest (a story button, once a rest has been taken this session). Once a session: +4 Devotion XP.

rites.name: Repay a Debt
rites.text: Pay back what you owe someone, in full (the Narrator marks it kept).

intervention.text: An enemy crits you: it becomes a normal hit.

hymns.name: Foreknowing
hymns.text: The next attack against an ally in sight misses.

hymns.name: Unravel
hymns.text: Every buff, shield and helpful state on an enemy in sight ends.

hymns.name: Cut Short
hymns.text: An enemy in sight makes a Heart save or loses its next turn (bosses lose 2 AP).

miracle.name: Rewoven
miracle.text: Your squad takes another turn, now, in initiative order.

taboo: Running is a debt, too.
Betrayal. Recorded. Permanently.
Your account is overdrawn.
witnessed: I am counting every move now.
intervention: An error in the ledger, corrected.
miracle: Once more from the last knot.
conversion: Your thread is in my loom now.
farewell: Account closed.
Your thread is cut loose. The knot stays.
Balance settled. Mostly.
